description: One plan step in full: title, detail, the target URL where it happens, the play it follows, the prerequisite slugs and whether they are met (unlocked), how it verifies (self, evidence URL or an automatic signal), minutes and cost, and founder_steps when part of the step is the founder’s own (an account, a handle): the exact page and what to do there, to hand over rather than do. Read it before working a step that next_steps or get_plan returned; the slug comes from those. Read-only; no side effects.

done.description: Step slugs already done — the "done" list of marketinque.json. Free tier only; a project's own ticks are used instead and this is ignored.

not_applicable.description: Step slugs the founder ruled out — the "not_applicable" list of marketinque.json. Free tier only; ignored for a project.

slug.description: The step slug exactly as get_plan or next_steps returned it, e.g. "p2-dest-alternatives".

traits.description: Product traits that decide which steps apply (b2b, b2c, ai-native, dev-tool, no-code, mcp, has-integrations, eu-traffic, mobile-app); omit for the generic plan. Free tier only; a project's saved traits are used instead.

name: get_step
title: One step in full
